![Guide to Khao Sok Floating Bungalows, Cheow Lan Lake](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07270929-1672-0139-0000-5fa99b28933f:4)
Khao Sok Village, officially named **Khlong Sok** , is the main jungle gateway hub located right outside the entrance to [Khao Sok National Park](https://www.khao-sok-riverside-cottages.com/guide-to-khao-sok-village/) in southern Thailand . It features local guesthouses, restaurants, and tour shops along the Sok River.[](https://www.khao-sok-riverside-cottages.com/guide-to-khao-sok-village/) [[1]](https://www.khao-sok-riverside-cottages.com/guide-to-khao-sok-village/)

Village Overview & Geography

- **Real Name:** Khlong Sok, set along Route 401 in the Phanom District of Surat Thani Province.
- **Location context:** Sits about 64 km (1-hour drive) away from Cheow Lan Lake, though many travelers mistakenly think they are side-by-side.
- **Atmosphere:** A laid-back, rustic backpacker hamlet surrounded by steep limestone cliffs and thick rainforest.[](https://www.khao-sok-riverside-cottages.com/guide-to-khao-sok-village/) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vGasnWik6KM&t=3)[[2]](https://www.khao-sok-riverside-cottages.com/khao-sok-national-park/)[[3]](https://www.muchbetteradventures.com/magazine/khao-sok-national-park-guide/)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cJVqUDR5uFs&t=4)

Where to Stay & Eat

- **Accommodations:** Offers budget hostels, eco-friendly jungle treehouses (like [Our Jungle House](https://www.khaosokaccommodation.com/) ), and river-view resorts.
- **Dining & Cafes:** Small local Thai restaurants, coffee shops, and spots like Blackstone Cafe and Little Wild Cafe.[](https://www.khao-sok-riverside-cottages.com/guide-to-khao-sok-village/) [[1]](https://www.travelfish.org/accommodation/thailand/southern_thailand/surat_thani/khao_sok_national_park/all)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vqbgIfJa6Wc&t=154)

Key Activities Nearby

- **National Park Access:** Walking distance to the main park gates for jungle trekking and night safaris.
- **River Adventures:** Tubing, canoeing, and bamboo rafting directly on the Sok River.
- **Lake Trips:** Day trips or overnight excursions booked from the village to stay in floating raft houses on [Cheow Lan Lake](https://khaosoklake.com/).[[1]](https://www.seeksophie.com/magazine/a/khao-sok-things-to-do-thailand)
